providers.notes: Already implemented on factory/continuous-coding; shared quota group.

adoption: Prefer existing OmniRoute provider registry/free catalog over adding duplicate provider integrations.
Use capability filters before quota/latency scoring.
Track quota identity separately from model identity so aliases/models do not multiply one shared allowance.
Distinguish daily exhaustion, temporary capacity, auth failure, model failure and provider outage.
Cooldown only the narrowest failed scope; preserve healthy sibling models/accounts.
Never rotate keys/projects to circumvent provider limits.
Require fresh canary evidence before Factory marks a provider healthy.
Never send private data to public/free workers unless that worker's data policy explicitly permits it.
